name: NGIN
purpose: Compose organizational, institutional and territorial operating capabilities for entities that govern, employ, serve, produce, transact and coordinate at scale.
authority_model: Organizational and territorial authority is scoped by the applicable human/legal/institutional authority boundary; NGIN cannot self-elevate authority.
data_model: Entity, role, membership, capability, workflow, evidence and relationship records with jurisdiction/context.
evidence_model: Operational and institutional actions retain evidence, provenance, authorization and accountable actor context.
economic_model: Can compose economic participation but delegates universal Value, Exchange, Settlement and I/O semantics.
pulse_model: Operational outcomes and value observations feed canonical Pulse pathways.
continuity_model: Institutional state, obligations, evidence and handoffs survive deployment or provider changes.
exit_handoff: Package organizational/territorial identity, active workflows, obligations, evidence, authority and integrations for canonical handoff.
